decision: statedSize { literal, citation } is optional on BuildingCandidateRefSchema, beside planEstimate.

Unlike planEstimate (computed by the read, so z.never() on retain_rooms), the literal exists only in the reader's output, so retain_rooms is its one door: a caller may supply it, and the server checks its citation as it checks the candidate's own (same original by SHA-256, a PDF-point region, page bound).

The task's third test, 'a retain_rooms candidate (never has one)', is therefore kept in the sense that holds: a stored candidate without one (the demo's 18) comes out of the read without one, and the read never adds, fills or guesses one. A test also shows retain_rooms accepts one and refuses a malformed one. This differs from the task's wording; the lead decides.
The card prints 'Stated on the sheet: <literal>' on its own line above the estimate; it is seen mocked, because no demo read holds one.
